verses.1: Now, beloved ones, I am writing to you a second letter. In this letter, I urge you to remember the sincere intentions of your hearts.
verses.2: To be reminded of the aforementioned warnings, as commanded by the holy prophets and apostles of you, and as commanded by our Lord and Savior.
verses.3: By this, we first learn that they are led on the last days of the week, according to their own desires, to be taken away by them.
verses.4: And those who say, “Where is the announcement of His presence?” In fact, everything has remained in that state since the time when our ancestors slept.
verses.5: For they want to make things confused. They wish that the heavens and the earth were separate from water, and that they could be united with God’s will through water.
verses.6: Because of this, the world was covered with water and lost its identity.
verses.7: And those heavens and the earth now are sealed by God’s commandment. They will be subjected to fire on the day of judgment, as a punishment for the sins of those unholy people.
verses.8: But let this not be a mistake for you, beloved ones: that one day with the Lord is like thousands of years, and thousands of years are just one day for us.
verses.9: The Lord of the message does not delay, as some believe that he delays. Instead, he is patient with you, not wanting to abandon anyone, but rather to bring everyone into repentance.
verses.10: And one day, the Lord will come as a thief. In that day, the heavens will be darkened, and all things stolen will be returned. The earth and everything on it will be found again.
verses.11: In all these ways being freed from such troubles, it is necessary that you remain in holy and devout transformations.
verses.12: expecting and fearing the appearance of that day of God’s presence, when the heavens will be filled with fire, and burning fragments will fall from them.
verses.13: And we expect to see new heavens and a new earth according to his teachings. In those heavens, justice will reign.
verses.14: Therefore, beloved ones, expecting these things, you should strive to be kind and harmonious towards him.
verses.15: And may you be saved through the patience of our Lord. As also our beloved brother Paul wrote to you about the wisdom that was given to him.
verses.16: Just as in all the other letters, where there are some things that seem strange or confusing, those who are ignorant and unwise people distort them, just like they distort all the other writings when they don’t understand them properly.
verses.17: Therefore, beloved ones, you should be careful not to be deceived by the deceptions of those who seek to deceive you. Instead, maintain your own principles and convictions.
verses.18: Let us also increase our grace and knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ. May His glory continue both now and forever. Amen.
